title: My MallWorld experience
content: I had this dream a few weeks before I knew anything about ‘mallworld’ and honestly I’m freaked tf out. So my dream started in what I think might have been one of the entrances to the mall this entrance lead into like a movie theater/auditorium with people coming in and out of yk like a normal building, right so I head inside and go into one of the rooms where there was a big white screen that was also some sort of stage, inside this room every single seat was taken except for one so I decided to take that one seat some how the people around me felt familiar or like I knew them from somewhere, when the movie or show started everyone turned around and started staring at me in that moment i got freaked out and left running and some how I ran deeper into the mall and I’ve ran into a big open area that had 4 or 5 floors of what I think were stores and food shops with the only way to get up to these floors was via these electrical escalators and these escalators would have certain points where they would connect and you could get on another one that would somehow take you to the floors you wanted. During this time I was walking around gawking at the things these stores had ( I can’t explain what they were I just knew it was something I’ve never seen before and it had me mesmerized) but when I tried going into one of these stores/shops someone wouldn’t let me in so I sneaked into one of a I think it was a toy store but it was more like gadgets like things or tools you would need but these items were futuristic or very advanced I took a small green brightly glowing glass ( or at least I think was glass ) marble and that’s when I think the security ine of the stores clerk started running after me because it saw that I stole that marble so I run to the escalators one again but this time it took me to a roof area where there was nobody ( keep in mind during all this time there was people walking around by themselves much like I was or some were together in small groups no more than 4 people ). And it felt like the outside I look over the edge and it’s the theater/auditorium entrance into where I came the sky was black with stars and a big massive shinning moon and as I’m looking around I see that the store clerk was in a similar roof area and that he was just staring me not yelling or pointing just staring it freaked me out and I saw that my area of the roof had a bridge that connected to a massive massive Mc Donald’s type early 2000s looking play place ( but it was cleaner and somehow looked kinda futuristic or just looked unused despite the amount of people going in and out of the thing ) so I ran to this bridge and head inside it was packed with people going in and out of this play place and everyone is chasing fire like balls of light that’s when I get the utterly extreme feeling that I needed to get one The feeling I got was a extreme extreme sense of desperation and that it was important to get one at all cost so I started chasing and catching and somehow holding them with my arm But then I saw it a slightly bigger orb of fire like light that changed colors from Dark green to a not so bright green color, As soon as I saw that orb that feeling of extreme desperation returned somehow multiplied to the point where I vividly remember tears flowing from my eyes like a river ( in the dream ) and I somehow ( I wasn’t necessarily holding them it was like once you catch them they would like float really close to you not making contact with you but close enough that it looked like that )let go of the orbs I already had and they floated away and as soon as I did I fully sprinted to that one ever changing green fire like orb the feeling of contempt and was just amazing. As I crossed to the other side of the bridge I started to notice that I was dreaming and you know that feeling when you are slowly waking up in a dream during this realization I had it was like the people or things that looked like people started noticing that I was waking up because they would start to follow me and start talking to me but I couldn’t hear them I woke up because someone in my dream grabbed my right shoulder and give it a squeeze. When I awoke I had tears in my eyes and jumped like when you’re falling asleep and suddenly feel like your about to fall of a building that jolt of awareness ( I tried to add or include every detail and feeling I could remember I am not role playing or making this up this is genuinely what I’ve dreamt about what I think is mall world it’s utterly terrifying that so may other people is dreaming things similar to me )
